scope: offline synthetic verification only; no actual model response/artifact opened
cli: python analyze_wsc.py --directory DIR --freeze-commit VERIFIED_SHA --freeze-time VERIFIED_UTC --manifest-sha256 VERIFIED_MANIFEST_SHA --protocol-sha256 VERIFIED_PROTOCOL_SHA --output-directory NEW_DIR
protocol_fidelity: Primary paired scoring is literalQ48 versus repaired binary, but selection policy is a registered unique raw-score abstraction, not the full significantly-higher-or-macroF1 policy.
bootstrap_implementation: Each cohort uses NumPy default_rng(base_seed+offset), offsets selection0/confirmation1/all2; draw F clusters by multinomial(F,uniform); carry all passages jointly. Metric averages remain passage-weighted; items have two tasks per passage. Percentiles .025/.975 use linear quantiles.
